lead_raw_text:
The structure of Ca2Bi6Se8 (reduced formula CaBi3Se4) crystallizes in the hexagonal space group P6_3/mmc (No. 194), with 16 atoms per unit cell distributed over four independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis identifies Bi centers in two octahedral environments (six Se neighbors each), while Ca and one Se orbit show eight geometric neighbors and another Se orbit has eight neighbors (four Bi, four Se). The neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component. Validated polyhedron-sharing relations include corner-sharing between Bi octahedra, and edge-sharing between Bi octahedra and the eight-vertex Ca polyhedra.
